description: This is a test class for the Account Data Access Object (DAO) in a Java Android project, specifically testing database operations related to Account entities such as insertion, updating API version, and display name management.

classes.name: AccountDaoTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing database operations related to Account entities using an in-memory Room database, utilizing Robolectric for Android environment simulation.

methods.name: setupDB
methods.description: Initializes the in-memory database before each test.

methods.name: closeDb
methods.description: Closes the database after each test.

methods.name: insertAccount
methods.description: Tests inserting a new account into the database and verifying stored values.

methods.name: updateApiVersionFromNull
methods.description: Tests updating the API version of an account from null to a value and verifying the change.

methods.name: updateApiVersionFromExisting
methods.description: Tests updating the API version to different values and null.

methods.name: updateDisplayName
methods.description: Tests updating the display name of an account and fallback to userName if displayName is null.
